countingRule: Counts refer to the 14 SEM-DIRECT dependency classes defined in architecture/sem-transition-map.md. A class is blocking only when SEM Full remains on the nominal product path. Rollback, historical replay and legacy-session reading are counted separately and are not silently treated as removed.

migratedFunctionalDependencies.evidence: api/scientific-interpretation.ts invokes the Scientific Interpretation runtime; the legacy endpoint is no longer the nominal browser/API path.
ScientificInterpretationWorkspace owns the visible conversation and current Contribution; legacy session conversion is lazy, read-only compatibility.
The Knowledge adapter consumes a Contribution and never authorizes Project adoption.
The nominal hybrid provider is owned by api/scientific-interpretation-provider.ts; the legacy provider/server are reachable only by the explicit rollback adapter.
Scientific Interpretation session/history preserves Contribution, raw, runtime, findings and projection identities; legacy identities remain reconstructible.
The browser client targets /api/scientific-interpretation and exposes the runtime-neutral response contract.
No nominal consumer imports the legacy facade; explicit rollback and legacy-session conversion retain the frozen module.

preservedNonBlockingDependencyClasses.reason: Prompts, schema, canonical identity, deterministic checks and composition remain frozen for reproducibility and rollback.
The page and transitional V1 projection consume the Contribution boundary without claiming PD-003 V2 conformance.
